full_judgment:
2. It appears that the plaintiff appellant petitioner instituted other suit No. 45 of 1988 for declaration of title in the suit land against the defendants. Admittedly the plaintiff appellant petitioner made statement in the plaint admitting the possession of Uttara Super Market (Pvt.) Ltd. Company, but the plaintiff appellant-petitioner did not make the said company as defendant in the suit. The plaintiff appellant petitioner also did not pray for any relief against the said company for recovery of possession of the suit land though the said company is admittedly in possession of the suit land. In the circumstances both the courts below found that the plaint is liable to be rejected. Further the trial Court also held that the suit is barred under section 3 of the Companies Act. In the instant case the said company having not been made a defendant in the suit we doubt whether section 3 of the Companies Act would be at all applicable (in the instant case). The appellate Court affirmed the judgment and order/decree of the rejection of the plaint passed by the trial court under Order 7 rule 11 of the CPC and dismissed the appeal. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and order of the appellate Court below the plaintiff petitioner has moved this Court. The plaintiff petitioner has filed an application for amendment of the plaint under Order 6 rule 17 of the CPC in this Court The said company having not been made defendant in the suit land and no prayer being made for recovery of possession of the suit land, we do not find any illegality in the judgment and decree of the appellate Court below in affirming the judgment and order of the trial Court. 

 4. For the reasons stated above we are not inclined to interfere with the judgment and decree of the appellate Court below. The Rule is accordingly discharged without any order as to costs.
